Equipment:Circulate Water Pump
 Single Stage Vertical Pump
 Bergeron Rateau - France

This document outlines 
the major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block.

This pump is used 
to transfer the coolant water from the River Nile to the condenser for 
condensing the steam from turbine to condensate water

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, reviewed by eng. Ahmed 
Fathy, tested by eng. Mamdouh Ghazy, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gelil: EDEPC 
inspection and quality control general director, accepted by eng. Mohamed Farag 
Anan: general manager, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag: head sector of 
Damietta (3x135MW) PS.

This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC planning & financial 
 predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of the pump 
 motor.

Isolate the pump mechanically by closing 
 suction and delivery valves.
Be sure that the pump is completely drained.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Filler.
Vibrometer.
Dial indicator.
Rags.
Grease.
Grinding machine.

Measure the vibration level of the pump and 
 record it.
Measure discharge 9pressure and record them.
Unbolt the nut 200.04.
Take out the washer 200.05.
Unbolt the screw.

Unbolt the nut 0201.02, raise the washer 
 0201.04 .
Raise the bolt 0201.01 .

Remove the nut 195.01 & the washer 195.02, 
 then remove the pin 189.00.

Using a bronze shim or a press, take out the 
 packings 257.01 & 257.00 and the bush 270.00.

Unbolt the nut 117.03 and raise the washer 
 117.02 .

Unbolt the screw 117.01 and raise the washer 
 117.02 .
Unbolt the pin 117.05 .
Clean all parts of the pump.
Change all the bearings of the pump.

Check all parts for any worn-out, replace the 
 damaged.

Check all parts for cracks, treat the cracks 
 by grinding or remachining.
Inspect the run-out of the shafts.
Change the wearing ring.

Measure the radial clearances for the pump 
 by measuring the gap between wearing ring of the diffuser and the distance 
 sleeve on the shaft and adjust them.

Grease the bearings of the pump. (type of 
 grease is multi-purpose grease).

Change the packing seal between the shaft 
 and the wear ring.
Repaint the casing against rust.
Put the bush 270.00 around the shaft.
Put the packing 257.00 and bush 257.01.

Insert pin 189.00 to lock the bushes and the 
 packing with the coupling and tight the screw 195.01.

Assemble the upper and lower parts of the 
 coupling by inserting the screw 201.01 and tightening the nut 201.02.

Insert the pin 117.05 and tight it (detail 6 
 ) (Figure 2).

Put washer 117.02 and insert the screw 
 117.01 ( detail 5 ) (Figure 2)

Put washer 117.02 and lock by nut 117.03. ( 
 detail 5 ) (Figure 2)

Assemble the upper coupling ( between the 
 intermediate and upper shafts ) as mentioned before in the lower coupling.
Assemble the upper shaft.

Insert the pin 118.01 and tight it (detail 7 
 ) (Figure 3)

Put washer 200.05, insert the screw 200.04 
 and tight it. ( detail 4 ) (Figure 3)

Check the oil level in the thrust bearing pump 
 bath.

Open the suction and delivery valves of the 
 pump.

Check the direction of rotation of the pump by 
 pushing the electric button of the motor instantaneously.

The temperature of the cooling water and the 
 anti-friction bearing
Any water and oil leaks
The discharge and pressure of the pump
Check the vibration level and record it.
